section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the development of the Body Appreciation Scale-2 (BAS-2), which involved drafting seven new items based on qualitative research themes on positive body image, resulting in 19 total potential items (eight original, four revised, and seven newly developed). An independent expert reviewer confirmed that the BAS-2 items were clearly worded and comprehensively assessed body appreciation. The authors decided against including negatively scored items to avoid distorting factor structures and potential confusion with body dissatisfaction.
